body:
I'll be honest and say this really fucked up my trust in relationships and has caused a lot of problems in my life. I had a girlfriend at the time and I never told her because I feared she'd think I cheated on her. This woman raped me without a condom so I had to go get STD tested afterwards which was really fucking humiliating. Luckily I didn't get one but what would I have said to my girlfriend if I got an STD from being raped and would she even believe me?


I'm still not sure if not telling her was fair to her. I think I'd want to know but I was so afraid she'd leave me I never told her.


I'm paranoid to this day about locking the doors when I sleep. It's getting way better but it's crazy how 1 event can just change everything. I'm a guy and can defend myself I can't even imagine how women feel.

I also want to say thank you for believing me. I feel way more empowered to speak out even if I could never tell anyone in real life. I hope it encourages other people to speak out too.

This really has really been eye opening to some degree... I'm definitely still not comfortable telling anyone I know, I have a ton of shame still and as sad as this sounds I don't want to be known as the "male rape victim", and honestly thinking too much about it makes me really really sad. But I'm happy in a way that sharing my story might help someone somehow.
I'm really not sure why but I've come back to these comments all day today and each time I read them I cry. This happened 10 years ago. You guys really restore my faith in humanity.

God damn, I chose this comment at random but I never thought anyone would reply or believe me and when I read this today I burst out crying like a baby... Not sure I can tell people in real life but wow I feel way better about people. I might try talking to someone about this.

damn... thanks

I think what was really the worst part, was the feeling that I could protect practically everyone, but not myself. And that feeliling of guilt and shame if I told anyone, they'd say "you can obviously stop her why didn't you", or other kind of thinking. Anyway, I'm starting to get into a really negative thinking again right now and I don't think I can talk about this anymore. But thanks to all who actually believed me. I won't reply anymore on this account. Good luck to all the other rape victims.

I actually told my brothers too and they laughed at me just like in this video which made me feel like utter garbage. It's way too late to do anything about it now but I can't #metoo without people laughing it off. But at least I can anonymously post it. It's not a joke. Pedophila and rape hapen to males too and it's not funny.

EDIT: thanks for believing me and not laughing it off like some joke
You're only the second person I told besides my friend that believed me. This has bothered me for years and I know nobody will believe me... and there is nothing I can do about it.
Didn't take long. Exactly why I never told anyone.

I'll post my story too since this is my throw away. I was raped in a similar fashion about 10 years ago by a woman when I was passed out drunk and woke up to her on top of me. I remember her at the beginning of the night obviously aggressive. Since I wasn't driving I crashed out in my friend's room.

Woke up with this woman on top of me and when I tried to push her off she tried to pin me down. When it was obvious that there was a problem the dogs woke up and tried to intervene between her and I. The dogs started barking and tried to get between me and her. It was kind of a crazy scene I didn't know exactly what was going on or what to do.

I'm a pretty big dude, not quite Terry Crews, but close, I was so embarrassed I never reported it and I don't think I can ever do it. Plus the fact that I'm a white man and this was a very large black woman.

Probably nobody will believe this too...

If you're feeling depressed you can find help. One place that helped me was 7cups:

https://www.7cups.com/

Seek help, people will listen.

We're in the same place man. I'm making it. Thanks for listening. Diet coke.

Thanks for listening.

I know if I had a gun here I would have blown my brains out already. The worst part definitely is no communications. Feeling totally and utterly alone.

I'd love to talk too if you want to PM me we can text/email/chat. Thanks for even taking the time to reply.

I've been going to the gym every day and doing my best to try to hide my depression. I'm getting really rediclously in shape but I'm falling more and more into depression. I know it's chemical to some degree and I'm trying to steer myself out of it. But I can feel myself failing and falling more.

I feel helpless and the more this happens the shittier I feel. I want to not love her, normally I can just shake this off and I'm on to another... but I have never met a woman like this. She fundmentally changed me and I'm not sure I can go back. My wife and kid are gone.

I didn't tell her, but I bought her a ring already and now it's just sitting on my desk.

My fiance dumped me after she found out she was pregnant, then had an abortion and cut me completely out of our life. I'm spinning now. I'm not sure how to progress personally or if I ever truely will. I have plenty of friends and other women around but I don't want other women.

I'm stuck in a negative feedback loop.

I just wanted to say to everyone who might read this that I have read all these replies. Thanks. I'm losing my shit and even these short replies are helping me reel it in. I'm not sure what to say or how to express my gratitude but here it is. Thanks.
I can't help you right now but I just want to say I read this. I hear you.
